'''Ghar Bodya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who was a member of the [[Exchange]], acting on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], an individual hired by [[Shayl Tasao]], the representative of the [[Exchange]] consortium on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Ghar Bodya.<ref name="TOR" /> The [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] killed a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] sent to assassinate him, and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] retaliation was costing all of them.

The individual hired to this job first crushed all the forces loyal to Bodya, and then lured him to the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] by destroying his [[Water/Legends|water]] supplies at some derelict [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]]. Bodya was defeated there and, as proof of his death, the individual in question took his head off and showed it to Tasao.<ref name="TOR" />
